qualifiers: real dinosaurs only: no pterosaurs or sea reptiles

answers.name: Tyrannosaurus
answers.fact: Had the strongest bite of any known land animal.

answers.name: Triceratops
answers.fact: Its frill and horns may have been for showing off as much as fighting.

answers.name: Velociraptor
answers.fact: Real ones were about turkey-sized, and feathered.

answers.name: Stegosaurus
answers.fact: Its tail spikes are nicknamed the 'thagomizer', after a Far Side cartoon.

answers.name: Brachiosaurus
answers.fact: Held its neck up high, like a giraffe.

answers.name: Diplodocus
answers.fact: Its long, whip-like tail may have cracked like a whip.

answers.name: Spinosaurus
answers.fact: Probably spent much of its time in water, hunting fish.

answers.name: Ankylosaurus
answers.fact: Swung a heavy bony club on the end of its tail.

answers.name: Brontosaurus
answers.fact: Dismissed as a mistake for a century, then reinstated in 2015.

answers.name: Archaeopteryx
answers.fact: A feathered link between dinosaurs and birds, found in 1861.

answers.name: Allosaurus
answers.fact: The top predator of late-Jurassic North America.

answers.name: Iguanodon
answers.fact: Early reconstructions stuck its thumb spike on its nose.

answers.name: Parasaurolophus
answers.fact: Its hollow head crest may have worked like a trumpet.

answers.name: Pachycephalosaurus
answers.fact: Its skull dome was up to 25 cm of solid bone.

answers.name: Apatosaurus
answers.fact: Brontosaurus's close cousin.

answers.name: Gallimimus
answers.fact: 'Chicken mimic', the stampeding dinosaur in Jurassic Park.

answers.name: Dilophosaurus
answers.fact: The real one didn't spit venom or have a frill.

answers.name: Carnotaurus
answers.fact: 'Meat-eating bull', with horns and tiny arms.

answers.name: Giganotosaurus
answers.fact: One of the biggest meat-eaters ever, rivalling T. rex.

answers.name: Argentinosaurus
answers.fact: One of the largest land animals ever, perhaps around 70 tonnes.

answers.name: Megalosaurus
answers.fact: The first dinosaur ever scientifically named, in 1824.

answers.name: Compsognathus
answers.fact: About the size of a chicken.

answers.name: Deinonychus
answers.fact: The real model for Jurassic Park's oversized 'Velociraptors'.

answers.name: Oviraptor
answers.fact: 'Egg thief', but it was really guarding its own eggs.

answers.name: Protoceratops
answers.fact: Its fossils may have inspired the legend of the griffin.

answers.name: Therizinosaurus
answers.fact: Had claws up to a metre long, probably for plants.

answers.name: Baryonyx
answers.fact: Found in an English clay pit in 1983, with fish scales in its gut.

answers.name: Microraptor
answers.fact: Had four feathered wings.

answers.name: Troodon
answers.fact: Had one of the biggest brains for its size of any dinosaur.

answers.name: Maiasaura
answers.fact: 'Good mother lizard', found with nests and babies.

answers.name: Edmontosaurus
answers.fact: A duck-billed dinosaur with hundreds of grinding teeth.

answers.name: Corythosaurus
answers.fact: Wore a crest shaped like a Corinthian helmet.

answers.name: Styracosaurus
answers.fact: Its frill was ringed with long spikes.

answers.name: Ceratosaurus
answers.fact: A Jurassic predator with a horn on its nose.

answers.name: Utahraptor
answers.fact: A giant raptor around 6 metres long.

answers.name: Plateosaurus
answers.fact: One of the first big plant-eating dinosaurs.

answers.name: Coelophysis
answers.fact: A fossil skull flew on the Space Shuttle in 1998.

answers.name: Hadrosaurus
answers.fact: The first near-complete dinosaur skeleton found, in New Jersey in 1858.

answers.name: Psittacosaurus
answers.fact: 'Parrot lizard', with a beak.

answers.name: Herrerasaurus
answers.fact: One of the earliest known dinosaurs.

answers.name: Albertosaurus
answers.fact: A smaller tyrannosaur cousin from Canada.

answers.name: Kentrosaurus
answers.fact: A spikier African cousin of Stegosaurus.

answers.name: Suchomimus
answers.fact: 'Crocodile mimic', with a long fish-catching snout.

answers.name: Dreadnoughtus
answers.fact: Named because it 'feared nothing'.

answers.name: Patagotitan
answers.fact: A titanosaur so long its casts barely fit in museums.

answers.name: Amargasaurus
answers.fact: Had two rows of tall spines down its neck.

answers.name: Mamenchisaurus
answers.fact: Its neck made up about half its body length.

answers.name: Ouranosaurus
answers.fact: Had a sail or hump along its back.

answers.name: Nodosaurus
answers.fact: An armoured dinosaur with no tail club.

answers.name: Euoplocephalus
answers.fact: Even its eyelids were armoured.

answers.name: Lambeosaurus
answers.fact: Wore a hatchet-shaped crest.

answers.name: Saurolophus
answers.fact: A duck-billed dinosaur with a spike-like crest.

answers.name: Tarbosaurus
answers.fact: T. rex's close Asian cousin.

answers.name: Yutyrannus
answers.fact: A huge feathered tyrannosaur from China.

answers.name: Sinosauropteryx
answers.fact: The first feathered dinosaur found; it had a ginger-striped tail.

answers.name: Eoraptor
answers.fact: One of the earliest dinosaurs, about fox-sized.

answers.name: Majungasaurus
answers.fact: Bite marks show it ate its own kind.

answers.name: Torosaurus
answers.fact: Might just be a grown-up Triceratops; scientists still argue.

answers.name: Centrosaurus
answers.fact: Found in huge bonebeds, a sign of big herds.

answers.name: Chasmosaurus
answers.fact: Had a huge frill with big holes in it.

answers.name: Pentaceratops
answers.fact: Had one of the largest skulls of any land animal.

answers.name: Camarasaurus
answers.fact: The most common sauropod in North America's Jurassic rocks.

answers.name: Supersaurus
answers.fact: One of the longest dinosaurs, perhaps over 30 m.

answers.name: Sauroposeidon
answers.fact: Could have raised its head about 17 m high.

answers.name: Nigersaurus
answers.fact: A wide mouth with hundreds of teeth, like a lawnmower.

answers.name: Leaellynasaura
answers.fact: Named after the daughter of the palaeontologists who found it in Victoria.

answers.name: Australovenator
answers.fact: Nicknamed 'Banjo', after the poet Banjo Paterson.

answers.name: Minmi
answers.fact: An Australian armoured dinosaur with one of the shortest names.

answers.name: Diamantinasaurus
answers.fact: A Queensland titanosaur nicknamed 'Matilda'.

answers.name: Irritator
answers.fact: Named for the irritation of scientists who found its fossil faked up with plaster.

answers.name: Mei
answers.fact: Found curled up asleep like a bird: 'soundly sleeping dragon'.

answers.name: Muttaburrasaurus
answers.fact: Named after Muttaburra, the Queensland town where it was found.
